title: Automation Primer
scenario: Welcome to Automation Primer. Before proceeding, you must master these essential networking terms. Command Line Interface (CLI): Text-based interface for device management. Used in routers, switches, firewalls. Key commands: show ip route, show interfaces, show vlan, debug, ping, traceroute. Faster than GUI for experts. Application Programming Interface (API): Interface for software components to communicate. REST APIs (HTTP/JSON) used for network automation and SDN. Enables programmatic device configuration vs manual CLI.
question: What does CLI stand for?
explanation: CLI stands for Command Line Interface.
